title: Thanks A Million: Mazda Toyota Manufacturing Celebrates One Millionth Vehicle by Giving Back to Community
summary: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. (Oct. 28, 2026) – Mazda Toyota Manufacturing (MTM) rolled its one millionth vehicle off the line, marking a major production milestone and an opportunity to reinforce the company’s commitment to North Alabama.
body_markdown:
*MTM marks milestone with community event, $120,000 in donations*


**HUNTSVILLE, Ala. (Oct. 28, 2026)** **–** Mazda Toyota Manufacturing (MTM) rolled its one millionth vehicle off the line, marking a major production milestone and an opportunity to reinforce the company’s commitment to North Alabama.


MTM celebrated the one millionth vehicle with both popular crossovers assembled at the plant, the Mazda CX-50 and the Toyota Corolla Cross, while highlighting the dedicated 4,500 team members and instrumental community partners that made the achievement possible.


“Reaching one million vehicles is an extraordinary accomplishment and a testament to the dedication, skill and teamwork demonstrated by our team members every day,” said Erik Skaggs, Senior Vice President for Mazda Toyota Manufacturing. “From the day we broke ground, our team has worked tirelessly to build not only world-class vehicles, but also a culture rooted in collaboration and teamwork.”


MTM announced $120,000 in grant funding to organizations that had supported the company with training and workforce development from start-up to present day. MTM highlighted the impact they have had on their team during the event. The organizations awarded include:


- Calhoun Community College
- Kids to Love
- Morgan County Schools
- Alabama Automotive Manufacturer’s Association


“Mazda Toyota Manufacturing has become an invaluable part of our community and regional economy,” said Chip Cherry, President and CEO of the Huntsville/Madison County Chamber. “Through their investment in local organizations, workforce development and regional partnerships, MTM continues to demonstrate what it means to be a great community partner. We are proud to celebrate this milestone alongside the entire MTM team and congratulate them on producing their one millionth vehicle.”


For more information about MTM, visit[www.MazdaToyota.com](http://www.mazdatoyota.com/) .

**About Mazda Toyota Manufacturing**


Mazda Toyota Manufacturing is a joint venture between Mazda Motor Corporation and Toyota Motor Corporation located in Huntsville, Alabama. The $2.3 billion facility has created over 4,500 jobs and assembles the Toyota Corolla Cross and Corolla Cross HEV, as well as the Mazda CX-50 and CX-50 Hybrid.
